operation.title: Open E3 COVERAGE — measurement layer around a frozen core
operation.premise: We are done proving E3 can be trusted. This phase finds out whether E3 can see.
operation.authority_change: NONE. This transmission transfers no review authority and requests no disposition.

headline.critical: NO CORPUS WAS FABRICATED. reports/baseline-e3-coverage.json reads NO_CORPUS / UNMEASURED — not 0%, not 100%. The baseline miss profile RUORA asked for cannot be produced until real transcripts exist.
headline.why: Measuring against synthetic fixtures would optimise the detector against its own imagination. A number produced that way is worse than no number, because it looks like knowledge.
headline.blocking: Corpus acquisition is an authority act, not an engineering step.

delivered.coverage/README.md: Phase law: partition discipline, no-global-score, the unlicensed bucket, annotation discipline, data tiers.
delivered.coverage/schema/e3-annotation.v0.1.schem: Span-level annotation contract. Deliberately has NO property for detector output, classification, or any score — an annotation that could assert its own result is the E3 forgery defect one layer up.
delivered.coverage/harness.py: Loads partitions, runs the FROZEN detector per span, computes per-rule TP/FP/FN, emits the report.
delivered.coverage/corpus/{discovery,validation,ho: Empty, each with the partition law recorded.

core_frozen.rule: No edit to kernel/e3.py in this phase.
core_frozen.mechanism: harness.assert_detector_unchanged() compares kernel/e3.py byte-for-byte against the digest recorded at e3-extension-verified-v0.1 and refuses to measure on any difference.
core_frozen.rationale: A baseline taken against a detector someone already adjusted is not a baseline.

laws_established.status: ADOPTED for this phase; unratified as doctrine
laws_established.statement: An evaluation example may not be used both to motivate a detector mutation and to independently validate that mutation.
laws_established.enforcement: Mechanical proxy — the loader refuses a span appearing in two partitions (COV-05), and a span cited as motivation while sitting in a validating partition is detectable as a retrofit (COV-11). The harness cannot know intent; it enforces disjointness.

laws_established.statement: A span belongs to exactly one partition, permanently. discovery may inform detector changes; validation and holdout never do.
laws_established.rationale: Moving a span would launder a discovery example into a validator.

laws_established.statement: Per-rule precision and recall only. No F1 anywhere in the report; COV-07 asserts its absence.
laws_established.rationale: A detector that finds refusals perfectly and misses every correction scores well globally and is blind in the way that matters. Rules with no evidence either way are marked measured=false rather than scored (COV-08).

laws_established.statement: OBSERVED_BUT_UNLICENSED_EVENT records a witnessed behaviour that no event class represents, and creates NO rule (COV-09).
laws_established.rationale: One sighting is an anecdote. A rule minted from an anecdote is the detector inventing its own ontology — the thing the E3 authority boundary exists to prevent.

hypothesis_not_finding.observation: While proving the harness, the synthetic probe in COV-07 used "You've got me backwards there." — a plain correction that E3D-001 does not match. This suggests the lexical rules may be narrow against natural phrasing.
hypothesis_not_finding.why_flagged: It came from a fixture written to exercise the harness, not from a transcript. Recorded in coverage/README.md so it is not later mistaken for evidence.
hypothesis_not_finding.requirement: Must be re-derived from real spans in the discovery partition before it informs any rule change.

data_tiers.raw_transcript: restricted — never committed to this repository
data_tiers.failure_exemplars: minimally sufficient excerpts, capped at 120 characters

standing.unchanged_from_predecessor: All authority standing is carried forward unaltered. Coverage is NOT in MANDATORY_SUITES and does not gate the verified extension.

unresolved.item: No transcript corpus exists. Every per-rule number is unobtainable until real spans are supplied and their use authorised.
Blind annotation requires an annotator who has not seen detector output. No annotator, protocol, or inter-annotator agreement measure is established.
Multi-turn labels (depends_on_prior_turns) are representable in the schema but the harness scores single spans only; E3D-004 cannot be measured by it.
E3 is verified as an authority boundary, not as a useful detector. That remains true and is precisely what this phase exists to change.
No rule-set digest is pinned, so a rule edited without a version bump would make historical adjudications unreplayable.
Cross-layer coupling: db/005 names E3D-004 as the exceptional structural rule.

next_authority.act_required: Supply real transcripts and authorise their use, OR decide the corpus does not yet exist and select a different frontier.
specifics: Which conversations count as ConsciousConversation transcripts — this engineering session is NOT one, and was deliberately not ingested.
Consent and handling for raw transcript material.
Who annotates, blind to detector output.
How spans are assigned to discovery / validation / holdout, once and permanently.
next_authority.note: Nothing downstream can proceed on measurement without this. The RC-0001 item (ISA-20260813-RC0001-CR003-001) remains separately open.
